//: Local development overrides. Loaded only when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development,
so nothing here reaches staging or production — those substitute ${DATABASE_URL}
Why this file exists: appsettings.json defaults DefaultConnection to port 6432,
which is PgBouncer. PgBouncer's pinned image does not exist on Docker Hub, so that
port has never been served locally, and the README quick start ('dotnet ef database
update') failed with 'Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1:6432' on a fresh clone.
These values match the postgres service in docker-compose.yml exactly — port 5432,
database upkilo_dev — and the connection string the integration tests already use.
